## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Amsterdam, Netherlands. It starts at Overhoeksplein 5.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Located atop the A’DAM Tower in Amsterdam-Noord, visit A'DAM Lookout for unmatched views of Amsterdam from an observation deck. See the city's historic center, the busy harbor, and the Dutch polder landscape. Spot the famous canals listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
>
> Engage with a modern interactive exhibition and use a free audio tour to learn about Amsterdam's history and culture.
>
> For thrill-seekers, try Europe’s highest swing, 'Over the Edge." Swing 100 meters above the ground and get the view of Amsterdam from a unique perspective.
>
> Your entry ticket also includes two drinks. Choose from coffee, tea, Heineken beer, house wine, or soft drinks.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €23.70. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 173 ratings and 109 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
